B is believed to hold, but would need the construction rerun inside connected invariant neighbourhoods with proper closure, not glue. B_to_A: A's main conjunct theorem_13_5_7 decomposes every structured tuple T over T's own data, keeping its sections on every U(x), and indexes the family by X; B gives only some common data c and an arbitrary index type J, so A's per-tuple and X-indexed form does not follow (reindexing a J-family by X is not a renaming when several summands share a point or X is finite).
overlap: No direction proved. The partial A_to_B_on (B with IsAtomicOn for IsAtomic) passes rt_check, using only A's hypothesis theorem_13_5_7_book.
